name: productivity-os
title: Productivity OS
description: Screenshot capture, clipboard history, floating shelves, health reminders, resource controls, and focus tools for macOS.
author: fimn

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Productivity OS
commands.description: All your tools in one place: screenshots, clipboard, Drop Shelf, health reminders, RAM, CPU priority, keep awake, and website blocking

commands.name: start-pomodoro
commands.title: Start Pomodoro
commands.description: Start the next protected focus round with your saved durations and websites, without opening a window

commands.name: pomodoro
commands.title: Pomodoro
commands.description: Open the Pomodoro timer: focus rounds, breaks, and the websites each round protects

commands.name: posture-coach
commands.title: Posture Coach
commands.description: Optional local posture reminders while you work, independent of Pomodoro; off until enabled and calibrated

commands.name: unlock-request
commands.title: Review Unblock Request
commands.description: Review unblocking sites after a one-minute pause; opened directly, it lists the blocked sites to choose from

commands.name: health-breaks
commands.title: Health Break Settings
commands.description: Set up eye, stretch, and water reminders and the optional local posture coach

commands.name: health-break-now
commands.title: Take a Health Break
commands.description: Show a gentle eye, stretch, and water break popup now

commands.name: drop-shelf
commands.title: New Drop Shelf
commands.description: Collect files, text, links, and images in a translucent floating shelf

commands.name: drop-shelf-clipboard
commands.title: Add Clipboard to Shelf
commands.description: Create a floating shelf with the current clipboard

commands.name: drop-shelf-settings
commands.title: Drop Shelf Settings
commands.description: Configure shake activation, shortcut, and login startup

commands.name: clipboard-history
commands.title: Clipboard History
commands.description: Search and paste your local text and code clipboard history

commands.name: clipboard-history-settings
commands.title: Clipboard History Settings
commands.description: Configure collection, privacy, shortcut, and login startup

commands.name: resource-guard
commands.title: Resource Guard
commands.description: Free RAM for Warp and agents by choosing other apps to quit; prioritize coding processes and coordinate heavy jobs

commands.name: capture-recording
commands.title: Record Short Clip
commands.description: Record up to two minutes of the screen, with optional audio, trimming, and GIF export

commands.name: capture-text
commands.title: Copy Text from Screen
commands.description: Select an area and copy its text, recognized locally on this Mac

commands.name: capture-scroll
commands.title: Scrolling Screenshot
commands.description: Capture a scrolling area vertically or horizontally, automatically or as you scroll

commands.name: capture-window
commands.title: Capture Window
commands.description: Click a window to capture it, then annotate, copy, save, or pin it

commands.name: capture-area
commands.title: Capture Area
commands.description: Drag over part of the screen to capture it; Space switches to window selection

commands.name: capture-screenshot
commands.title: Capture Screenshot
commands.description: Open the capture overlay to choose an area, window, display, text, or recording

commands.name: screenshot-studio
commands.title: Screenshot Studio
commands.description: Every capture, annotation, OCR, scrolling, and recording tool in one searchable list

commands.name: block-site
commands.title: Block Site
commands.description: Block a website by domain

commands.name: unblock-site
commands.title: Unblock Site
commands.description: Review and unblock a website after a one-minute pause; unfinished focus rounds stay protected

commands.name: blocked-sites
commands.title: Blocked Sites
commands.description: List blocked websites; unblock one, a tag, or everything

commands.name: block-preset
commands.title: Block Preset
commands.description: Block or unblock a whole preset of websites (Social, News, Video)

commands.name: start-focus-session
commands.title: Start Focus Session
commands.description: Block a preset for a set duration, then auto-unblock

commands.name: quick-focus
commands.title: Quick Focus
commands.description: Start a focus session right from the search bar: pick what to block and for how many minutes (default: Social for 30)

commands.name: focus-status
commands.title: Menu Bar Focus Timer
commands.description: Menu bar lock icon and countdown for focus sessions and Pomodoro rounds, with quick website, screen, and tool controls

commands.name: toggle-color-filters
commands.title: Toggle Color Filters
commands.description: Turn the macOS Color Filters accessibility setting (e.g. Grayscale) on or off

commands.name: toggle-menu-bar-icons
commands.title: Toggle Menu Bar Icons
commands.description: Hide or show the menu bar icons to the left of the Productivity OS divider

commands.name: lock-keep-awake
commands.title: Lock Screen and Keep Awake
commands.description: Lock the screen while the Mac keeps running: starts a keep-awake session that lets the display sleep (empty: no time limit; replaces a running session), then locks

commands.name: amphetamine-start
commands.title: Start Keep Awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for Amphetamine's default session length; leaves a running session alone

commands.name: amphetamine-quick-start
commands.title: Quick Keep Awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for the hours, minutes and seconds typed inline (all empty: no time limit); replaces a running session

preferences.name: displaySleepAllowed
preferences.title: Display Sleep
preferences.label: Allow the display to sleep during the session
preferences.description: When enabled, the session keeps the Mac awake but lets the display turn off.

commands.name: amphetamine-end
commands.title: End Keep Awake
commands.description: End the current keep-awake session

commands.name: amphetamine-remaining
commands.title: Keep Awake Time Remaining
commands.description: Show the time remaining in the current keep-awake session

commands.name: amphetamine-configure
commands.title: Configure Keep Awake
commands.description: Keep the Mac awake for a duration (empty: no time limit) or until a specific time; replaces a running session

commands.name: run-setup
commands.title: Run Setup
commands.description: Verify the helper installation and show the setup command

scripts.test: python3 tests/helper.test.py && python3 tests/setup-scripts.test.py && node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/lib.test.cjs tests/ui.test.cjs tests/native-launcher.test.cjs tests/screenshot-studio-client.test.cjs tests/clipboard-history-client.test.cjs tests/drop-shelf-client.test.cjs tests/health-breaks-client.test.cjs
scripts.build:resource-priority: swiftc -O native/resource-guard/Core.swift native/resource-guard/Apps.swift native/resource-priority/Priority.swift native/resource-priority/main.swift -o assets/resource-priority
